review_comments.body: Could we add an IPv6-mode case, so we know a mapped allow rule is still skipped there?
Thanks for scoping this down. Is there an issue tracking the IPv6 except variant, so #742 isn't closed by mistake?

Added `TestFWRuleProcessor_IPv4MappedCIDRSkippedInIPv6Mode` (62109cd): with IPv6 enabled, `::ffff:10.0.0.0/104` canonicalizes to the IPv4 network 10.0.0.0/8, is skipped, creates no 10.0.0.0/8 entry, and does not add its port to the IPv6 entries (`2001:db8::/32` keeps only port 80).

On the except variant: there is no separate issue; it is the "Except variant" section of #742 itself, and this PR does not touch the except handling. The PR description doesn't use a closing keyword, so merging it won't close #742; I've changed its first line to "Part of #742" to make that explicit. Happy to open a separate issue for the except variant if you'd prefer to track it on its own.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
Lgtm, Thank you for the contribution.
